primary_metric: mean accuracy across clean, noise(.2,.4,.6), dropout(.05,.15,.30), and joint(.4,.15),(.6,.30) conditions
primary_comparison: candidate minus ordinary all-pixel corruption augmentation control, paired by seed; fixed selected C=10, gamma=0.01

hyperparameters_selected_on_validation.selection: highest mean validation accuracy across the three seeds for the control among the preregistered grid; no held-out tuning

control: same augmented pool count and noise/dropout draws, all pixels augmented, no variance weights or collapsed mask
pass_rule: support only if candidate mean held-out paired delta > 0 and positive in at least 2 of 3 seeds; otherwise no_gain/inconclusive; exploratory only, no significance claim
known_implementation_issue: StandardScaler after per-feature multiplication cancels all nonzero scalar feature weights exactly; candidate therefore differs from control only through collapsed-feature masking and augmentation restriction. This is faithful to the stated order and is a central mechanism falsification.
